errors.invalid_link: This link does not work any more. Please ask the rental station for a new one.
errors.request_closed: This request is closed. Thank you, nothing more is needed.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries in a short time. Please wait a minute.
errors.consent_missing: Please accept the privacy notice to continue.

start.title: Report damage to your rental car
start.intro: It takes about four minutes. We already filled in what we know.
start.privacy_text: We use your answers, photos and location only to handle this damage. The rental company and its claims partner receive them. We keep them for {days} days after you send the report, unless the claim needs longer.
start.consent_privacy: I have read the privacy notice
start.consent_location: Use my location for the place of the incident and the photos
start.resume_hint: You can stop at any time. Open the same link to continue.
start.known_none: Nothing yet. We ask for your rental details in the next steps.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: [CONFIRM] Placeholder text for the prototype. The final notice names the controller, the purposes, the legal basis, the recipients, the retention period and your rights. This prototype contains test data only.

injured.title: Is anyone injured?
injured.call_hint: Help first. You can finish this report later with the same link.

police_reference.title: Police reference number
police_reference.help: It is on the paper the police gave you. Skip it if you do not have it.
police_reference.label: Reference number

vehicle.title: Is this your rental car?
vehicle.agreement_help: On your rental agreement or in the confirmation email.
vehicle.help_unknown: The plate is on the car, the key ring or your rental agreement.

contact.title: How can we reach you?
contact.help: Only for questions about this damage. One of the two is enough.
contact.need_one: Please give an email address or a mobile number.

incident_type.title: What happened?
incident_type.single_vehicle_hint: For example a post, a kerb or an animal
incident_type.parked_unknown_hint: The car was parked or you do not know how
incident_type.theft_breakin_hint: The car or things in it

when_where.title: When and where did it happen?
when_where.located: Pin set from your location. Drag it to the exact place if needed.
when_where.denied: No location. Tap the map to set the pin.
when_where.map_label: Map, tap or drag the pin to set the place

other_party.title: The other vehicle
other_party.help: Copy it from their papers or from the incident report form.
other_party.name: Driver's name

irf.title: Did you fill in the incident report form?
irf.help: It is in the glove box. Both drivers fill it in and sign it.
irf.no_form: There was no form in the car

hit_object.title: What did you hit?
hit_object.object: An object, like a post or a wall

found_at.title: When did you find the damage?

theft_kind.title: What was stolen?
theft_kind.break_in: Break-in, things taken from the car
theft_kind.parts: Parts of the car, like wheels or mirrors

keys.title: Do you still have the car keys?
keys.help: The insurer will ask for them.

drivable.title: Can you still drive the car safely?
drivable.help: If not, the station arranges another car.

description.title: Tell us in your own words
description.help: A few sentences are enough. For example: I hit a parked car while reversing.
description.label: What happened

damage.title: Where is the car damaged?
damage.help: Tap every part that is damaged. Tap again to undo.
damage.selected: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {# part selected} other {# parts selected}}

photos.title: Photos
photos.help: Follow the outline. Good light and the whole part in the picture.
photos.location_note: Time and place are saved with each photo.

scene_overview.title: Overview of the scene
scene_overview.hint: Step back. Both cars and the road in one picture.

own_damage.title: Damage to your car
own_damage.hint: Close, the whole damaged part in the frame.

other_damage.title: Damage to the other vehicle
other_damage.hint: The whole damaged part in the frame.

other_plate.title: License plate of the other vehicle

irf_front.title: Incident report form, front
irf_front.hint: Flat, all four corners visible, signed.

police_report.title: Police report
police_report.hint: Photo or PDF. You can add it later.

glass_closeup.title: Glass damage close up
glass_closeup.hint: Hold a coin next to it for size.

witnesses.title: Were there witnesses?
witnesses.help: Only add people who agree to be contacted.
witnesses.name: Name
witnesses.consent: This person agrees to be contacted

review.title: Check before sending
review.gaps_note: You can send now and add the rest later with your personal link.

station.title: Where did you rent the car?
station.help: Pick the station where you collected the car.

injured.label: Injuries
injured.why: Injuries change how fast we act.

police.label: Police yes or no
police.why: Tells us if a police report exists.

police_reference.label: Police reference
police_reference.why: We need it to get the police report.

vehicle_plate.label: Your license plate
vehicle_plate.why: We need it to find the car.

rental_agreement.label: Rental agreement number
rental_agreement.why: Links the damage to your rental, so we do not need to ask for more personal details.

contact.label: Email or mobile number
contact.why: Without it we cannot ask you a question.

location.label: Place
location.why: Needed to judge who is liable.

description.label: Your description
description.why: Your own words help the handler most.

damage_zones.label: Damaged parts
damage_zones.why: The station can plan the repair.

collision_kind.label: Kind of collision
collision_kind.why: First indication of who is liable.

other_plate.label: Other vehicle's plate
other_plate.why: Without it we cannot claim from the other party.

other_insurer.label: Other party's insurer
other_insurer.why: Speeds up the claim against the other party.

other_contact.label: Other driver's contact
other_contact.why: Needed if the other party disagrees.

irf_status.label: Incident report form
irf_status.why: A signed form avoids long discussions.

keys_present.label: Car keys
keys_present.why: The insurer asks for them after a theft.

items_taken.label: Stolen items
items_taken.why: Needed for the police and the claim.

drivable.label: Safe to drive
drivable.why: Tells the station if you need another car.

photo_scene_overview.label: Photo of the scene
photo_scene_overview.why: Shows the situation as it was.

photo_corner_front_left.label: Photo front left
photo_corner_front_left.why: Shows earlier damage, so you are not charged for it.

photo_corner_front_right.label: Photo front right
photo_corner_front_right.why: Shows earlier damage, so you are not charged for it.

photo_corner_rear_left.label: Photo rear left
photo_corner_rear_left.why: Shows earlier damage, so you are not charged for it.

photo_corner_rear_right.label: Photo rear right
photo_corner_rear_right.why: Shows earlier damage, so you are not charged for it.

photo_other_damage.label: Photo of the other vehicle
photo_other_damage.why: Matches the damage on both cars.

photo_other_plate.label: Photo of the other plate
photo_other_plate.why: Proves who the other party is.

photo_irf_front.label: Report form, front
photo_irf_front.why: The signed form is the strongest proof.

photo_irf_back.label: Report form, back
photo_irf_back.why: The sketch and remarks are on the back.

photo_police_report.label: Police report
photo_police_report.why: Required by the insurer after police involvement or theft.

station.label: Rental station
station.why: The station handles the repair and a replacement car.

done.title: Thank you. Your report is in.
done.next_1: The rental station and the claims team receive your report now.
done.next_2: We contact you only if something is unclear.
done.next_3: Missing something? Add it with your personal link within 30 days.
done.gaps: {count, plural, one {One item is still missing.} other {# items are still missing.}} You can add them now or later.
done.link_help: Keep this link. It opens your report to add documents.

docreq.title: Please add these documents
docreq.intro: For report {reference}. Take a photo or choose a file.
docreq.done: Thank you. We received everything we asked for.

home.title: Report damage to a rental car
home.body: Scan the QR code in the car, on your rental agreement or at the station to start.

demo.title: Demo QR codes
demo.intro: Fictional stations and vehicles. Scan with a phone or tap Open.

kinds.agreement: QR code on the rental agreement

demo.disabled: The demo page is switched off.
demo.switch_note: Changes this page right away. A scanned QR code always shows the theme of its own rental company.

hints.agreement: Everything is known: station, car and agreement.
hints.vehicle: Station and car are known. The driver adds the agreement number.
hints.station: Only the station is known. The driver adds car and agreement.
hints.email: Nothing is known except the rental company. The driver adds station, car and agreement.

demo.email_sample: Damage to your rental car? Report it online in a few minutes.
demo.email_note: Example of the link at the bottom of a rental email.

admin.title: Admin
admin.themes_intro: Each rental company can have its own look. A theme is public only when the brand use is confirmed.
admin.login_help: Test login until Microsoft Entra ID is connected. Your name is stored with every change.
admin.login_unavailable: Sign in is not available. Ask the administrator to set the demo password.
admin.status_published: Public. Brand use confirmed by {name} on {date}.
admin.logo_help: SVG or PNG, at most 200 KB. SVG files with scripts or links to other files are refused.
admin.permission_label: We have written permission from the brand owner to use this logo and brand
admin.permission_required: Required to save a theme with a logo. Your name and the date are stored.
admin.permission_draft: Without this confirmation the theme is saved as a draft. Drafts are only visible behind login, never on a public link.
admin.contrast_blocked: This theme can not be saved until every check passes.
admin.saved_draft: Saved as draft. Only visible behind login.
admin.preview_draft: Preview of a draft. Not public until the brand use is confirmed.

errors.invalid_input: Check the fields. Colours look like #1A2B3C.
errors.permission_required: Tick the brand permission box to save a theme with a logo.
errors.logo_too_large: The logo is larger than 200 KB.
errors.logo_type: Use an SVG or PNG file.
errors.logo_unsafe: This SVG contains scripts or links and is refused.
